children: Generali’s nine-month 2026 net income rose to €3.60bn, while adjusted income climbed 12% to €3.68bn and operating profit gained 8.5% to €6.45bn. Premiums grew 4.5%; disaster losses totaled €1.5bn.

Generali said it remains on track to exceed its 2027 plan targets. Its Solvency Ratio was 211% at September-end, down from 219% at 2025 year-end, amid wider bond spreads and market volatility.
Assicurazioni Generali reported record €1.8 billion in catastrophe and human-caused claims over the first nine months, including losses from wildfires in southern Europe and hail in Italy.
Assicurazioni Generali S.p.A. (G) reported a 23.2% increase in its Asset & Wealth Management operating result to more than €1 billion. Life net inflows rose 13.6% year over year to €11.7 billion.
